Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a __proteinaceous shell comprising a plurality of__ bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides.

Claim 8 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 __wherein the proteinaceous shell further comprises at least one different BMC polypeptide from a different bacterial species.__ 

Claim 10 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 __wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides is selected from BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.__ 

Claim 12 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising a plurality of bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides.

Claim 21 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising a plurality of bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product, wherein the product comprises a bioactive product resulting from metabolic conversion.
